# 如果 …，就 … · *jyu4 gwo2 …, zau6 …*

**Meaning:** if …, then … · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Connecting words

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fjyu4-gwo2-if).

如果 introduces the condition and 就 the result. 就 goes after the subject of the second half, before the verb.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **如果聽日落雨，我哋就唔去喇。** |
| Jyutping | jyu4 gwo2 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 laa3. |
| Yale | yùh gwó tīng yaht lohk yúh, ngóh deih jauh m̀h heui la. |
| Bopomofo | ㄩ⁴ ㄍㄨㄛ² ㄊㄧㄥ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄌㄛㆶ⁶ ㄩ⁵, ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄉㄝㄧ⁶ ㄗㄜㄨ⁶ ㆬ⁴ ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | If it rains tomorrow, we won't go. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **如果你得閒，就嚟我屋企食飯啦。** |
| Jyutping | jyu4 gwo2 nei5 dak1 haan4, zau6 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6 laa1. |
| Yale | yùh gwó néih dāk hàahn, jauh làih ngóh ūk kéi sihk faahn lā. |
| Bopomofo | ㄩ⁴ ㄍㄨㄛ² ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄉㄜㆶ¹ ㄏㄚㄣ⁴, ㄗㄜㄨ⁶ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄨㆶ¹ ㄎㄝㄧ² ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄈㄚㄣ⁶ ㄌㄚ¹. |
| English | If you're free, come to my place for dinner. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **如果唔明，可以問我。** |
| Jyutping | jyu4 gwo2 m4 ming4, ho2 ji5 man6 ngo5. |
| Yale | yùh gwó m̀h mìhng, hó yíh mahn ngóh. |
| Bopomofo | ㄩ⁴ ㄍㄨㄛ² ㆬ⁴ ㄇㄧㄥ⁴, ㄏㄛ² ㄧ⁵ ㄇㄜㄣ⁶ ㆭㄛ⁵. |
| English | If you don't understand, you can ask me. |
